title: A Directional Connectivity Feature Enhancement Network for Pavement Crack Detection
venue: IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems
mechanism: Multi-directional enhanced convolution plus a directional-connectivity loss on neighbouring pixels for cracks.
adaptation: Port only the directional-connectivity loss to the crack head of the house model; closest-domain evidence for DconnNet-style outputs.
min_experiment: Arm = PF + directional connectivity loss on crack; baseline = PF; 5 seeds; components found, relF1@2. Kill if gain < 0.01.
evidence: R: +2.2% ODS and +1.8% mIoU on DeepCrack; +1.2 ODS, +0.9 mIoU on Crack500; six crack datasets.
